data.name: Umineko Music Pack
data.description:
WARNING: DUE TO GOOGLE DRIVE DELETING FILES WHEN UNZIPPED DOWNLOAD BOBBY’s MUSIC PLAYER FIRST AND THEN THIS MOD. MOVE ONLY THE AUDIO FILES NOT THE DLL. ALT SOLUTION: Download the ZIP files from my link in Bobby’s Mod Page and then unzip them to a folder or desktop

Finally I’m done. Last Music mod upload. Mod adds in the OST and several 07th songs and fansongs from the VN Sound Novel Umineko When they Cry to SPT.

Music Submod for Bobby’s Main menu music mod.

Install Instructions: ………………… YOU KNOW HOW TO INSTALL. Drag BepinEx folder into the SPT Directory.

Preview: https://youtu.be/yNS9g4ct-nk?si=VjJa0vRMSi4ixQ1m

Updated to SPT 3.10.X

Updated to SPT 3.11.x version

versions.description: Updated mod to 3.10.5/x versions of SPT. It requires Bobby's Main menu Music mod. Install: Drag the BepinEx folder into your SPT Directory. Mod is updated to SPT 3.11 use Bobby's Music Player then upload this over top if you get issues with music or mod not working. No I will not change the red text it's important for the this specific mod.
